description.describe_ch: 本課程主要介紹換能器的基本原理、架構、等效電路和應用方法，其中包括換能器的構成，換能器的分類及要求、換能器的靜、動態數學模型以及機電模擬與分析法，以及當代新型換能器的發展狀況與應用。透過本課程的教學，使學生掌握換能器靜態、動態的數學模型的推導以及系統的物理概念的分析方法，並結合實際應用實例，培養學生設計、分析麥克風、受話器、揚聲器及壓電換能器的能力。
description.describe_eh: This course provides students the basic concepts analytical skills, and the state of the art techniques in electroacoustic transducers, such as receivers, loudspeakers, microphones, and earphones. Bring them to a level that they can establish physical model of an electroacoustic transducer, and prepare them doing independent research in the electroacoustic area. Both theory and practical application in sound-producing and sound-receiving transducers will be emphasized.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解電聲換能器的基本原理與架構。
targets.describe_en: Understand the principles and structures of electro-acoustic transducers.

targets.describe_ch: 能建構各式各樣麥克風、揚聲器與受話器之數學模型，進進而能分析與設計麥克風。
targets.describe_en: Be able to setup and formulate models for any kinds of microphones、speakers and receivers, and then to design and analyze microphones.

targets.describe_ch: 學習如何蒐集有關電聲換能器相關資料、規範問題，應用所學加以分析驗證，並有撰寫專業報告及論文之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to collect data and define questions of electro-acoustic transducers. In addition, carry out analysis to obtain conclusions as well as to develop abilities in thesis writing.

targets.describe_ch: 學習當代換能器(如耳機、MEMS 產品)的發展狀況與應用。
targets.describe_en: Study the state of the art techniques in transducers (such as Earphones and MEMS Devices) and their applications.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 瞭解電聲換能器的基本原理與架構。

courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to apply fundamental scientific knowledge and systematic thinking to explore, analyze, and diagnose electro-acoustic engineering problems and develop sustainable solutions.

courseBankC.describe_en: Be able to setup and formulate models for any kinds of microphones、speakers and receivers, and then to design and analyze microphones.
courseBankC.core_item: 具備應用數學模式來描述、分析電聲工程相關問題，並有規劃與執行專題研究，以解決複雜且整合性工程問題之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Proficiency in applying mathematical models to describe and analyze electro-acoustic engineering problems and planning and executing research projects to solve complex, integrated engineering problems.

courseBankC.describe_en: Be able to collect data and define questions of electro-acoustic transducers. In addition, carry out analysis to obtain conclusions as well as to develop abilities in thesis writing.
courseBankC.core_item: 蒐集資料、規範問題、加以分析驗證獲得結論，並有撰寫專業論文之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to collect data, define problems, analyze and verify conclusions, and write professional papers.

courseBankC.core_item: 具備掌握國際電聲發展趨勢及對於環境永 續、社會共好及全球發展的影響，培養技術接軌之能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: The ability to understand global trends in electro-acoustic development and cultivate technological convergence while considering the impact of environmental sustainability, social well-being, and international development.
